name: Adventures in Babysitting
notes: Jason works security at a nightclub to keep an eye on Andrés de León.

name: Afternoon Delight
notes: Vicki wants to rob her boss, Frankie Delight, at the Delights strip club on ladies' night, and split the takings with Jason and Lucia.

name: Amateur Hour
notes: Lucia backs up a contact called Cisco when he goes to confront a film director.

name: Ambulance Chaser
notes: The ambulance from the hospital getaway is hidden in a barn near the Starlet Motel. Lucia has to catch it and burn it before the police find it.

name: Another Life
notes: A Chapter 4 flashback: Lucia thinks back to a morning with her young son Tomas, before she was arrested.

name: Bad Driver!
notes: An optional Chapter 4 job: find Felipe, who works with Raul's crew and has gone missing.

name: Behind on Payments
notes: Lucia owes Linda $900 for the motel room. Raise the money and settle up at reception, which also gets back anything Linda kept as collateral.

name: Bird in the Hand
notes: Chapter 5 opens with Jason and Lucia stealing a new ride.

name: Blood Sweat and Gear
notes: A Chapter 4 mission: Lucia puts in a hard workout at the gym.

name: Boobie Time
notes: Jason drives Boobie Ike around Vice City on his errands, which ends with an introduction to Yasmani at a smoke shop.

name: Breakfast Run
notes: Jason is back on his feet, and he and Lucia go on a run of stick-ups, starting at Hank's Waffles and moving on to a liquor store and a thrift store.

name: Bricked Up
notes: Boobie sends Jason and Lucia to Venture Apartments in Rockridge to collect bricks the San4San gang owes him, and the visit gets out of hand.

name: Buck Me
notes: Lucia needs a bank account for her community service pay, so Jason meets her at the Fleeca branch in Key Lento. Bad credit points them to the BuckMe app instead.

name: Building a Life
notes: Back at the house, Jason and Lucia put a coffee table together at the second attempt, and Jason shows Lucia how to handle a gun.

name: Buy Flowers
notes: An optional Chapter 1 errand: order flowers for Lucia at a stand in southern Key Lento and have them sent to the house. It improves their relationship.

name: Buy Lucia a Necklace
notes: An optional Chapter 1 errand: buy Lucia an engraved gold chain at The Siren's Chest for $475. Worth doing, as it comes in handy in Chapter 2.

name: Call Nate
notes: A Chapter 4 task: Lucia rings Nate, a new contact.

name: Call Valentina Back
notes: A Chapter 4 task: Valentina is waiting for a call back.

name: Car Service
notes: Raul makes contact from a blocked number with a job: Lucia slips into a chop shop, steals a Schafter V12 and drives it to Leonida Auto World.

name: Cash Injections
notes: Lucia spends some time with Nate and lends a hand to one of his associates.

name: Caught Slipping
notes: Thieves break into the Bayside apartment, so Jason and Lucia chase them down, then find a safer place to keep their things.

name: Checking Out
notes: The last mission of Chapter 2: Jason and Lucia pack up and leave the Starlet Motel for Vice City, though getting away isn't as quiet as they hoped.

name: Child's Play
notes: A Chapter 4 mission: Jason and Lucia do a favour for someone they know.

name: Clean Up After Donnie
notes: A package from Donnie's botched drop is beeping near a fishing spot in the swamps south-west of Hamlet. Jason tracks down the missing goods and takes them to Donnie's trailer.

name: Clear Skies
notes: Brian and Donnie have a flying job for Jason that starts in Southwind: escort another plane in, then watch a deal at a swamp airstrip.

name: Clock Out
notes: An optional Chapter 1 pick-up: Lucia finishes early at the Key Lento Community Center and needs a lift home before 4pm. The call doesn't always come.

name: Close Surveillance
notes: Jason flies a spy drone to keep tabs on a group of bodybuilders.

name: Coffee Break
notes: Over a $2 coffee in the motel kitchen, Jason and Lucia plan their next steps. From here on you can switch freely between the two.

name: Coming Home
notes: Lucia is about to walk out of Hamlet Correctional. Jason picks her up, and the two head to the Rusty Anchor to celebrate with friends.

name: Company Cars
notes: Valentina has arranged new cars, so the Y Hotel car service drives Jason and Lucia to Status Auto Imports to choose one each.

name: Company Property
notes: Brian owes Raul a favour, so Jason and Lucia help him collect a weapons delivery from Pilot Pete at an airfield south of Hamlet.

name: Cooties
notes: Lucia helps Dre'Quan shoot a music video for the Real Dimez song Cooties, starring DWNPLY's stolen car.

name: Credit Check
notes: Raul invites Jason and Lucia to his base to meet the crew, then sends them on a string of Fleeca bank robberies across Vice City.

name: Crosstown Traffic
notes: A two-part job for Raul: Lucia tails a gang member onto the Metro while Jason follows boats down the river with Karim on the line.

name: Daily Driver
notes: Moses wants an '82 Canis Crawler taken back from clients who never paid. Lucia grabs it and delivers it, with $500 extra if it arrives in good shape.

name: Day Release
notes: Kat and Mattia invite Jason and Lucia out for a day of partying that starts at the Rusty Anchor and carries on aboard a yacht off Vice City.

name: Dealer's Choice
notes: Boobie says the apartment comes with a favour, so Jason rides along with Dre'Quan on a drug deal and gets to choose which product to sell.

name: Delivery Method
notes: A Chapter 4 mission: Jason goes undercover to help Andrea.

name: Deposit Cash Into BuckMe
notes: A short Chapter 1 task with no map marker: pay some pocket cash into the BuckMe account at any ATM, such as the one beside Jason's house.

name: Dirty Work
notes: Jason and Lucia deal with Raina, from the Ajax Gym crew, and new opportunities open up as a result.

name: Discharge Time
notes: The last mission of Chapter 1: Lucia heads to Vice City Hospital, where trouble soon catches up with her.

name: Doggie Bag
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: meet a man called Vinny and go looking for some contraband.

name: Don Gone
notes: Brian sends Jason to pack up Donnie's belongings at his trailer in Key Lento, then get rid of Donnie's car somewhere out of town.

name: Donnie's Lost Drugs
notes: An optional Chapter 1 dive: Donnie's boat went down off Corsair Key with drugs on board. Find the wreck, take the bag and sell it to Brian.

name: Down to Earth
notes: Brian has a job for Jason at the marina, and Lucia comes along to see what he does all day. It ends with a sea plane trip to Bobcat Bay.

name: Dubious Provenance
notes: Jason and Lucia take the statue from the bag to an antiques shop in Capri to find out what it is, and meet the dealer Benedict Halifax.

name: Encrypted Hard Drive
notes: A Chapter 3 task: dig into the locked hard drive that came out of the bag and find out more about it.

name: Feng Shui
notes: Jason and Cal spend a night at home shuffling the furniture around before Lucia is released, then try out a couple of games on Cal's console.

name: Find the Lost Drugs
notes: An optional Chapter 1 hunt: follow beeping signals across four swamp zones to find lost drug packages, then sell them to a fence.

name: First Impressions
notes: Jason and Lucia meet Raul Bautista for the first time, picking him up in Ocean Beach and shaking off the police along the way.

name: Fresh Evidence
notes: Jason and Dre'Quan go after material that could be used for blackmail.

name: Fully Catered
notes: A Chapter 4 job: Jason and Lucia steal a catering truck.

name: Gear Up
notes: Jason calls in at his local Ammu-Nation to choose a long gun, a shotgun or a tactical rifle, and has company waiting outside when he leaves.

name: Get Lucia's Clothes
notes: An optional Chapter 1 errand: Lucia's friend Andy rings Jason, who collects a bag of clothes for Lucia from her at the Manatee's Rest bar.

name: Get Shirley's Rum
notes: Optional and missable (Chapter 1): Jason's neighbour Shirley wants a bottle of rum from the liquor store down the road. It goes away for good once Tourist Trap begins.

name: Get The Chop
notes: An optional Chapter 1 errand: Jason gets a new haircut or tidies up his beard at Barnacle Beauties in Key Lento before Lucia comes home.

name: Get Your Wheels
notes: An optional Chapter 3 task: get hold of a set of wheels in Vice City.

name: Girls' Trip
notes: Jason needs proper painkillers, so Lucia asks around the motel. The trail leads to Vicki, a dancer at Delights, and her dealer Dunk.

name: Gone Fishing
notes: Jason and Cal scoop up drug packages dropped at sea from Donnie's plane, then a deal in the swamp turns sour and Jason heads into Kingfishers territory in Pelican Valley.

name: Headliners
notes: The Real Dimez play VYB, and Jason and Lucia help make the launch party a success.

name: Heavy Lifting
notes: Raul wants the hard drive and intel on a rival crew led by bodybuilder Kordell Grant, so Jason and Lucia go undercover at Ajax Gym.

name: Heist Planning
notes: A Chapter 3 task: go over the plan for the coming bank job with the crew.

name: Heist Plans in Place
notes: A Chapter 4 task: the preparation is done and the airport heist is ready to go.

name: Here, Kitty Kitty
notes: Tyrone wants a man called Charles found. Jason follows the trail from an apartment in Rockridge to a homeless camp in La Perle.

name: Hey Arnold!
notes: Brian's long-time broker Arnold has stopped picking up, so Jason and Cal track him down in Maroon Key. A chase follows, and Jason has to decide what happens to him.

name: Hidden Charges
notes: Karim needs explosives planted on cell towers around Vice City to cover the bank job. Jason and Lucia can split the work between them.

name: Hit Avery Pawn
notes: An optional Chapter 2 job: Jason and Lucia rob Avery Pawn in Port Gellhorn, smash the display cases and fence the jewellery.

name: Hit Kingpin Bowling
notes: An optional Chapter 2 job: storm a bowling alley taken over by the Kolts gang, blow the safe and grab a unique shotgun and a luxury watch.

name: Home Sweet Home
notes: Lucia goes back to Jason's house in Key Lento to grab some of his things, finds unwelcome visitors there, and has to slip out of the area.

name: Honest Abe
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: Jason and Lucia try to strike a deal with their lawyer, Abe.

name: How Do I Look?
notes: A quick Chapter 2 task: Lucia buys a new top and some trousers or shorts at Bargain World in southern Port Gellhorn.

name: Impounded Vehicle
notes: An optional Chapter 2 job: Lucia's car has been towed to the impound near the Port Gellhorn police station. Break in and drive it out.

name: Island Dreams
notes: Treasure hunter Kenton has Jason lead a bachelor party on a dive to a shipwreck, which doubles as cover for a treasure search. Unlocks underwater treasure hunting.

name: It's a Date!
notes: A Chapter 4 night out for Jason and Lucia, just the two of them.

name: Just a Scratch
notes: Jason drives his battered '70 Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care for a free engine repair and a respray, a quick introduction to Pay 'n' Spray garages.

name: Just Moved In
notes: Lucia shops for supplies at the Alpha convenience store across from the motel, from soup and gauze to hair clippers, and takes them back to the room.

name: Lab Fees
notes: Brian's rent is overdue at a Key Lento gift shop that hides an acid lab in the back. Jason takes payment in kind and drops it at Brian's lockup.

name: Lawyer Up
notes: Valentina finds Jason and Lucia a lawyer, and they visit Abe Gonzalez at his Downtown office to see what he can do for them.

name: Making Gainz
notes: Raul comes up with a new plan, and Lucia makes a new acquaintance along the way.

name: Mami Knows Best
notes: Lucia catches up with her mother, Mia, who has just started selling houses, and helps clear up her first listing in Hamlet.

name: Meet the Heders
notes: Jason and Lucia join Brian and Lori Heder for dinner at a rooftop bar, and the evening turns into a job at the dockyard.

name: Moses
notes: Lucia drives a low-key car to Moses, a Port Gellhorn mechanic, who explains vehicle trackers and hands her a Slim Jim for getting into locked cars.

name: Nate Will Be in Touch
notes: A Chapter 4 task: lend Kordell's crew a hand while you wait for Nate to call back.

name: New Look
notes: A quick Chapter 2 task: Lucia gets a new hairstyle at the Pearl House Hair Salon in Port Gellhorn.

name: Ocean Beach
notes: Chapter 4 opens with Jason and Lucia moving into a suite at the Y Hotel, arranged by Valentina, who also promises to find them a good lawyer.

name: Operation Savage Glory
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: a valuable shipment has to be recovered.

name: Overnight Charges
notes: Lucia stops at the Starlet Motel reception, where the manager, Linda, wants the room paid for straight away.

name: Painkiller Supplier
notes: A Chapter 2 waiting task: Dunk will ring with a lead on painkillers for Jason. It takes two calls spread over a few in-game days.

name: Party Hard
notes: To cover the lawyer's bill, Valentina gets Jason and Lucia work guarding telenovela star Andrés de León at a launch party Downtown.

name: Pay Abe's Fee
notes: A Chapter 4 task: the lawyer's help isn't free, so pay Abe his fee.

name: Pay Abe's Fee (Chapter 5)
notes: A Chapter 5 task: Abe's bill comes round again, so pay the lawyer a second time.

name: Photo/Shoot
notes: A Chapter 4 mission: Jason and Lucia team up with Dre'Quan to film a promo.

name: Pick Up a Gun
notes: An optional Chapter 2 stop: Lucia buys a weapon at the Port Gellhorn Ammu-Nation, or takes one of her own guns out of the locker there.

name: Pick Up Groceries
notes: An optional Chapter 1 errand: buy a few groceries in Key Lento and carry them into the house before Lucia comes home. It improves Jason and Lucia's relationship.

name: Pipework
notes: Brian sends Jason to collect rent from his tenant Mandy, who won't pay until her blocked kitchen sink is fixed, and who has other ideas besides.

name: Pool Day
notes: Jason and Lucia spend a lazy day by the Y Hotel pool, ordering cocktails and people-watching, and a man called Eddie Acosta invites them to a party.

name: Power Play
notes: A Chapter 4 job: help Kordell's crew and pick up useful intel along the way.

name: Prepare for Vice City
notes: An ongoing Chapter 2 goal: raise at least $15,000 while Dre'Quan finds the couple a place in Vice City. It unlocks the chapter's final mission.

name: Prologue
notes: The opening mission: Lucia, serving time at Hamlet Correctional, sits down with prison counsellor Stefanie, and a flashback shows the robbery that put her inside.

name: Protective Custody
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: Jason and Lucia work together and meet with their lawyer, Abe.

name: Race Against Yago
notes: Optional and missable (Chapter 3): Yago invites Jason to a race meet in Salton for a limited time. The prize depends on where you finish, up to $3,800 for a win.

name: Rafa
notes: A Chapter 4 mission for Jason involving a man called Rafa.

name: Raul's Next Job
notes: A Chapter 3 task: wait for Raul to get in touch about the crew's next job.

name: Recalibration
notes: Cal is having a rough time, so Jason and Lucia bring him beer and take him fishing. This is Chapter 1's point of no return, so save first.

name: Ride or Die
notes: Dre'Quan wants revenge on DWNPLY, so Jason helps him talk his way into a VIP lounge and make off with DWNPLY's car.

name: Safe Word
notes: Nicole wants Lucia to practise on a smaller version of the bank's safe, kept in a mansion in Peacock Estates. Jason has to blend in on a film set to reach it.

name: Save for the Future
notes: A Chapter 1 task: keep paying into Family Savings to reach the next goal. Each goal raises the BuckMe account limit and adds discounts.

name: Security Expert
notes: Jason and Lucia head to Waning Sands to bring in Nicole Park, a security expert the heist crew can't do without.

name: Send Money to Lorena
notes: A short Chapter 3 task: transfer a payment to Lorena.

name: Send More Money to Lorena
notes: A short Chapter 3 task: make a second payment to Lorena.

name: Sinfrontera National Bank
notes: Raul has Jason and Lucia case Sinfrontera National Bank in Tequesta, noting cameras, guards and security, as planning for a big job begins.

name: Slam Dunk
notes: Dunk has a plan for getting Jason stronger painkillers, starting with a retired doctor called Bill and a visit to the Kolts gang at the docks.

name: South Leonida Real Estate
notes: Mia calls Lucia back to the house in Hamlet, and another run-in with the M7 gang turns into a property tour for their boss.

name: Starting From Zero
notes: The final mission of Chapter 4.

name: Steal the Scooter
notes: Optional and missable (Chapter 1): Shirley's second favour has Jason taking her neighbour Peggy's mobility scooter. It goes away for good once Tourist Trap begins.

name: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy
notes: Randy wants a high-end Zorrusso from a garage in Ocean Beach. Jason and Lucia take it with a Key Cloner and outrun its tracker. Bonus if it arrives undamaged.

name: Sunset
notes: A Chapter 4 mission: Jason and Lucia go in search of answers.

name: Swamped
notes: Brian takes Jason on the long drive to the Kingfishers camp in north-west Mariana County for a sit-down with the gang.

name: Take Care of Jason
notes: An ongoing Chapter 2 task: Lucia looks in on Jason in their Starlet Motel room at the end of each day while he recovers.

name: Taking Liberties
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: a fresh plan starts to take shape.

name: Team Building
notes: Lucia meets Kordell and his crew and has to show them what she can do.

name: That's Where the Money Is…
notes: An optional Chapter 4 mission: wait at a café for someone to turn up.

name: The Cartel Heist
notes: The last mission of Chapter 3: the crew hits Sinfrontera National Bank, where the cartel launders its money.

name: The End of the Road
notes: The last mission of the GTA 6 story, closing out Chapter 5.

name: The Missing Link
notes: Lucia teams up with Andrea to meet Monty, a cartel enforcer, at an illegal cockfight in Watson Bay.

name: This Is a Free Call From…
notes: Optional and missable (Chapter 4): Lucia gets a call from someone who needs picking up. It only stays open for a limited time.

name: Tie Up Loose Ends
notes: With the airport job done, a few loose ends still need tying up.

name: Too Much Baggage
notes: Jason scouts the airport and takes a turn at handling baggage.

name: Top Billing
notes: Dre'Quan brings Jason and Lucia to the Jack of Hearts to see the Real Dimez perform, but the night soon goes off script.

name: Tourist Trap
notes: Mattia offers Jason and Lucia an easy job, fetching a bag from a locker at the Visitor Center, that could lead to better-paid work. The last free roam of Chapter 1.

name: Tyrone
notes: Jason calls on Tyrone, the dealer from his first job with Dre'Quan, to ask about some work.

name: Unfinished Business
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: some unfinished business still needs dealing with.

name: Unwanted Attention
notes: Cal and Jason drive to Hamlet to recover money owed to Brian, stashed in a car sitting in the police impound. Along the way Cal puts a police scanner on Jason's phone.

name: VC Baby
notes: A Chapter 5 mission: Mattia gets back in touch and asks for help.

name: VCIA Takedown
notes: The big job at VCIA, the Vice City airport, finally goes ahead.

name: Watch It
notes: A Chapter 4 mission: Jason and Dre'Quan go to see a nightclub owner.

name: Welcome to Vice City
notes: Chapter 3 opens as Jason and Lucia drive into Vice City and meet Jason's old friend Dre'Quan at the Jack of Hearts strip club in Crosstown.

name: What's in the Bag?
notes: Chapter 2 opens in a Port Gellhorn motel, where Lucia finally goes through the bag from the locker and finds a small statue and a hard drive.

name: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
notes: An optional Chapter 3 job list: Yasmani wants one piece from the safe of each of three Vice City jewellers. Deliver all three for $20,000 and a Snap Gun.
